messages:
emma.prod: getting a bunch of 401s from billing-ingest in prod since 09:12 UTC. response body: {\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\"}. no config changes on our side AFAIK :/

carl.support: thanks — can you paste a failing curl (with the header masked) and the env from one of the pods? also which deployment was rolled?

emma.prod: curl reproducer:
```bash
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \"https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate\" -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```

and from inside the pod:
```bash
# kubectl exec -it billing-ingest-6f7d9 -- env | grep REDWOOD
# output:
REDWOOD_API_KEY=
```

emma.prod: note the secret is present in k8s: kubectl get secret billing-secrets -o yaml shows data: redwood_api_key: <base64> (lowercase key)

carl.support: aha — can you paste the deployment env snippet? suspect key name mismatch.

emma.prod: deployment snippet:
```yaml
env:
  - name: REDWOOD_API_KEY
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: billing-secrets
        key: REDWOOD_API_KEY
```

carl.support: yep — secret has key named \"redwood_api_key\" (lowercase) but the deployment expects \"REDWOOD_API_KEY\" (upper). Kubernetes will set the env var to an empty string when the key is missing -> requests sent with empty key -> 401 invalid_api_key.

sam.infra: assigning remediation: update either the secret to contain the uppercase key or change deployment key to match. quick fix we applied: patched the deployment to use the lowercase key and restarted the pods. patch: `kubectl patch deploy billing-ingest -p '{\"spec\":{\"template\":{\"spec\":{\"containers\": [{\"name\":\"billing-ingest\",\"env\": [{\"name\":\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\",\"valueFrom\":{\"secretKeyRef\":{\"name\":\"billing-secrets\",\"key\":\"redwood_api_key\"}}}]}}}}}'`

deploy-bot: rollout restarted deployment/billing-ingest (2 replicas)

emma.prod: confirming — after restart the env shows REDWOOD_API_KEY=REDACTED and calls are succeeding. no more 401s for 10m. thanks! :tada:

carl.support: root cause: secret key name mismatch in k8s -> empty env -> unauthenticated. recommended: update infra docs to standardize secret key name, add CI check so secretKeyRef.key is validated at deploy time, and add a short runbook for this common 401 case.

sam.infra: created infra ticket INF-842 to standardize secrets across services and add a pre-deploy validation job.

emma.prod: marking resolved on our side, will follow up if it recurs.

carl.support: closing thread — let us know if anything else shows up.
